A slip: a printed strip showing both game-text strips of the location card (title, icons and corrected game text; the Dark Side strip upside down) around an empty middle, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-ordmantell-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Ord Mantell (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. As a slip it has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
